column1: # RuneLite 1.13.3 clientscript overlays (client-1.13.3.jar runelite/12/<id>.hash): RuneLite replaces script <id> with its own
# version only when sha256(script data) equals this hash. The built cache must keep these scripts byte-identical to
# BASE 2746 (client CACHE_NEEDS 1, SFP-19), or bank tags, chat commands, friend notes, zoom limits ... silently stop working.
